item.title: Don't Miss Friday Night Frights Softball Tournament, Turkey Bowl
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Sign Up Today for the Friday Night Frights Softball Tournament

Are you ready for the frightfully fun Friday Night Frights softball tournament? Registration is now open!

This softball tournament will be held on Oct. 27 from 6-10:30 p.m. for both men’s and co-ed divisions. Sign up today to snag your spot at the spookiest tournament of the year! You don’t want to miss it.

Learn more about our softball tournaments.

Don’t Miss the Turkey Bowl

Are you ready for the last adult softball tournament of 2023? Don't miss the 10th annual Turkey Bowl!

Registration for this adult softball tournament will be held Oct. 20-Nov. 3. The Turkey Bowl will be held Nov. 11-12. 

Did you know that $25 from each registration will be donated to the Mid-Ohio Food Collective? Give back to your community for the holiday season while playing a sport you love!

Learn more about our softball tournaments.

50+ Basketball League Starts Soon

The 50+ basketball league season kicks off with three open gym sessions starting Sunday, Oct. 15. The open gyms are at 1 p.m. on Oct. 15, 22 and 29 at Barack Community Center. Registration is Now Open for The Columbus Classic Presented by White Castle

Registration for The Columbus Classic is coming to a close! This is one of the best tournaments of the year and a great way to celebrate July Fourth weekend! Make sure you register for your team’s spot by Friday, June 23. The Columbus Classic presented by White Castle will be held July 1-2.

This is an adult softball and a youth baseball tournament. The Columbus Classic started in 1988, and for 36 years, this tournament has continued to grow and change just as this city has.  

More information on pricing, offerings and important dates can be found on our website.

Kickball Registration is Now Open!

Spring kickball registration opened on Friday and will close on April 14.This coed seven-week league starts on April 23 with games being played on Sundays and Thursdays at Anheuser-Busch Sports Park and on Tuesdays at Lou Berliner Sports Park. The season concludes with playoffs for teams that are qualified.

Check out the rules and league fee or register.

Do you need to join a team or looking for additional players? Don't forget to check out the Free Agent List.

Sign your team up today and play softball with Columbus Recreation and Parks!
